name: Orders placed and cancelled without intent to execute
description: Large orders are repeatedly entered and withdrawn before execution, or small orders are layered, in a way that moves the visible price or depth in favour of positions held elsewhere.
fp: Market makers and algorithmic strategies legitimately cancel at high rates. Compare to the customer's stated strategy and the benefit on related positions.

links.name: Orders placed and cancelled without intent to execute
links.ctx: Manipulative price-formation behaviour that precedes a profitable trade and is only visible in order-level data.
